reviews.shade: [ZO&FRIENDS EDITION] Cell Fusion C Aquatica Cooling Sunscreen 35ml+35ml Double Set (+10ml+Keyring)
reviews.text: Cette crème solaire est légère et ne laisse pas de traces blanches. L’odeur n’est pas désagréable. La série limitée Zoa est vraiment très mignonne et le porte clé est très pratique pour faire des retouches au cours de la journée
reviews.zh: 呢款防曬霜好輕盈，唔會留低白色痕跡。味道唔會令人反感。Zoa 限量系列真係好得意，鎖匙扣好方便，日間可以攜帶嚟補妝。

reviews.shade: [ZO&FRIENDS EDITION] Cell Fusion C Aquatica Cooling Sunscreen 35ml+35ml Double Set (+10ml+Keyring)
reviews.text: Definitely bought it for the packaging! Love the collab and super cute with the mini sized one! Great for summer has cooling effect and good formula to glide on skin!
reviews.zh: 一定係因為包裝先買嘅！好鍾意個聯乘，細裝嗰款好得意！夏天用好啱，有清涼效果，配方塗抹時好順滑！

reviews.shade: [ZO&FRIENDS EDITION] Cell Fusion C Aquatica Cooling Sunscreen 35ml+35ml Double Set (+10ml+Keyring)
reviews.text:
キーリングが予想よりデカくてびっくり笑かわいくて使うのが勿体無い💕
いろんな日焼け止め試すのが趣味なのでたくさん使ってきたけどその中でもアクアティカクーリングは上位に入る使い心地の良さ！メイク重ねてももろもろでない！35mlになっちゃったのが悲しいけどストックないと不安なくらい好き…
reviews.zh:
鎖匙扣比我想像中大，嚇咗一跳，好可愛，捨唔得用💕
我嘅興趣係試各款防曬，用過好多，不過當中アクアティカクーリング嘅使用感絕對係前幾位！疊上化妝都唔會起粒！雖然縮咗做35ml好傷心，但係鍾意到冇存貨就會唔安心咁。

reviews.shade: [ZO&FRIENDS EDITION] Cell Fusion C Aquatica Cooling Sunscreen 35ml+35ml Double Set (+10ml+Keyring)
reviews.text: The texture is so smooth and you can feel it slightly cooling. This was my go to sunscreen for so long. Even after reformulations I stuck through it. However I may need to switch to another sun screen because this has alcohol and makes my skin very sensitive after prolonged use. I love the texture and the feel and it gives great protection but I wish that the ingredients are sensitive skin friendly
reviews.zh: 質地好順滑，塗上去會有少少清涼感。我用咗好耐，一直都係我嘅首選防曬，即使配方改過之後我都一直用。不過我可能要轉用其他防曬，因為呢款含有酒精，長時間用之後皮膚會好敏感。我好鍾意質地同手感，防曬效果都好好，但希望成分可以更適合敏感肌。

reviews.shade: [ZO&FRIENDS EDITION] Cell Fusion C Aquatica Cooling Sunscreen 35ml+35ml Double Set (+10ml+Keyring)
reviews.text: I adore this collaboration! Restocking. The keychain is very convenient travel size. Small amount, but very effective. Cooling and soothes which is great for summer and irritated skin. No irritation and does not sting my eyes.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢個聯乘！又再補貨。鎖匙扣款式好方便，攜帶容易。份量少，但效果好好。有清涼同舒緩效果，夏天同皮膚不適嘅時候用都好啱。冇刺激，亦唔會令眼睛刺痛。

reviews.shade: [ZO&FRIENDS EDITION] Cell Fusion C Aquatica Cooling Sunscreen 35ml+35ml Double Set (+10ml+Keyring)
reviews.text:
It's better then i expect. no sticky and no white marks.
it's suitable before applying as base for make up. Will buy again.
reviews.zh:
比我預期好。唔黏，亦冇白印。
好適合喺上妝前用做底。會再買。

reviews.shade: [ZO&FRIENDS EDITION] Cell Fusion C Aquatica Cooling Sunscreen 35ml+35ml Double Set (+10ml+Keyring)
reviews.text: Collaboration keychain is so cute! Great value. A little on the small side for sunscreens, but it is so soothing and has a nice cooling sensation for hotter weather.
reviews.zh: 聯乘鎖匙扣好可愛！性價比好高。對防曬產品嚟講有少少偏細，但好舒緩，天氣熱嗰陣有好舒服嘅清涼感。

reviews.shade: [ZO&FRIENDS EDITION] Cell Fusion C Aquatica Cooling Sunscreen 35ml+35ml Double Set (+10ml+Keyring)
reviews.text: Cell Fusion C Aquatic is my favorite version. I have combination skin and live in a hot and humid environment. I keep coming back for this sun screen. It is soft and moisturizing. I love the gift it came with! Thank you~
reviews.zh: Cell Fusion C Aquatic 係我最鍾意嘅版本。我係混合肌，住喺又熱又濕嘅環境，所以一直返嚟買呢款防曬。質地柔軟又保濕。我好鍾意附送嘅禮物！多謝～

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
